steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: Practise the whole question and answer. First cover the French and say the idea in English. Then say the French line without stopping between words.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.explain: Mon rendez-vous est à 9 h 30. means My appointment is at 9:30..

steps.title: In Canada
steps.body: In a written schedule, you may see 9 h 30. When you speak, say neuf heures trente. In conversation, people may also say neuf heures et demie. Both tell you 9:30.

steps.title: Speaking: Say your appointment clearly
steps.body:
Choose a day, a date and a time. Say the day first, the date, then the time. Repeat the full appointment once, as if you were confirming it by phone.

• Pause briefly between the day, date and time.
• If you do not understand, use the phrase from Unit 2: Pardon ? Plus lentement, s'il vous plaît.

steps.fr: Bonjour. Mon rendez-vous est mardi, le 14 avril, à 9 h 30. C'est bien ça ? Merci.
steps.en: Model answer. Say it in your own words after.
steps.tip: Listen, then say it out loud. Tap Ask Marie to have her listen to you.
